doc_verification.detail: constraint source_url https://milvus.io/docs/limitations.md Resource Naming Rules 未单独抓取（domain 访问由上游 R2 补锚时已核，evidence_tier=verified/quoted）；规则内容（字母或下划线开头、仅字母数字下划线）与 Milvus 官方 limitations 一致，无版本特异表述；endpoint 契约 endpoint registry 覆盖 entities/insert 与 entities/query。

execution_evidence.log_pattern: insert dyn field '123field' -> http=200 ok=True raw={"code":0,"cost":0,"data":{"insertCount":1,"insertIds":[100]}} / query outputFields=['123field'] -> ok=False raw={"code":65535,"message":"parse output field name failed: 123field"}
secondary_observations: insert dyn field '@field' -> http=200 ok=True raw={"code":0,...,"insertIds":[101]}}；query -> code:65535 parse output field name failed: @field
insert dyn field 'my-field' -> http=200 ok=True insertIds:[102]；query -> code:65535 parse output field name failed: my-field
insert dyn field 'field name'(含空格) -> http=200 ok=True insertIds:[103]；query -> code:65535 parse output field name failed: field name
insert dyn field 'f$eld'(含$) -> http=200 ok=True insertIds:[104]；query -> code:65535 parse output field name failed: f$eld
insert 255-char valid name -> ok=True（合法边界内对照，通过）

http_semantics.note: insert 侧 HTTP 200 + code:0 接受非法名（客户端错误被静默吞掉）；query 侧拒绝也以 HTTP 200 + code:65535 返回

contract_grounding.assertion_text_quoted: field names: ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$, length<=255, enforced at insert-time (dynamic fields included)
contract_grounding.note: 5 类非法动态字段名（123field/@field/my-field/含空格/含$）均违反 ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ 且被 insert 以 code:0 接受——violates=True 直接成立；且写入后 query 无法回读（数据可访问性断裂），是约束明确要求 insert/query 一致校验的反面。

chain_links: doc: Resource Naming Rules——字段名仅字母数字下划线、字母/下划线开头
script: boundary_r2_dynfield_name_insert_01.py 向 enableDynamicField=true collection insert 5 类非法名动态字段并 query 回读
log: insert http=200 code:0 ×5；query code:65535 'parse output field name failed: <name>' ×5

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST insert → handler_v2.insert (L1234 checkAndSetData) → utils.go L592-621 动态字段仅做 gjson 类型转换、无字段名校验 → anyToColumns L947-957 序列化为匿名 JSON 列（FieldName="", IsDynamic=true, L1202-1217）→ 静默接受。query → getOutputVectorField 路径 L1637-1664 → ParseIdentifier 按标识符语法解析 → 非法名解析失败 → 65535 拒绝 → 写入数据不可回读。

evidence_weight_rationale: 四环齐全（verified 契约 + 官方命名规则文档 + raw log 逐字 code:0/65535 + 源码定位到未调用的 validateFieldName 与 query 侧拒绝点），且产生数据可访问性断裂的持久后果；insert/upsert 双脚本稳定复现。
